scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test:ci && npm --prefix backend run test:ci
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.dev: sh -c 'npm --prefix backend run dev & BACK_PID=$!; npm --prefix frontend run start -- --dev-client; kill $BACK_PID'
scripts.dev:lan: sh -c 'npm --prefix backend run dev & BACK_PID=$!; npm --prefix frontend run start:lan; kill $BACK_PID'
scripts.dev:tunnel: sh -c 'npm --prefix backend run dev & BACK_PID=$!; npm --prefix frontend run start:tunnel; kill $BACK_PID'
